# 法華經入疏

**ID:** X0600
**Volume:** X30
**Category:** 法華部類
**Original Category:** 大小乘釋經部／法華部疏
**Byline:** 宋 道威入注
**Dynasty:** 宋
**Date:** 960–1279
**Juans:** 12
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/X0600

## Contributors
- 道威 (A001518)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A twelve-*juan* Sòng-period subcommentary on the Lotus Sūtra by Dàowēi 道威, a Sìmíng 四明 (Níngbō) Buddhist master whose biographical details are largely unrecorded. The genre — *rùshū* 入疏 ("inserted-into-subcommentary") — indicates a commentary in which Dàowēi's own annotations are interpolated directly into the text of an existing earlier subcommentary, with the goal of producing a unified text in which original commentary and supplementary annotation can be read together. The work is preserved as X30n0600 in the *Xùzàngjīng*.

**Abstract**

The *Rùshū* — "inserted-subcommentary" — is a genre in which a later commentator's annotations are interpolated directly into the text of an earlier subcommentary. The base text Dàowēi worked on is not securely identified in the surviving recension; on the basis of his Sìmíng affiliation it is most plausibly the standard *shānjiā* commentarial corpus on the Lotus, possibly [知禮](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%9F%A5%E7%A6%AE) Zhīlǐ's [Tiāntái Sìmíng] *Pǔmén* commentaries ([KR6d0047](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0047), [KR6d0049](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0049)) extended through the *Wénjù*-based exegesis. The twelve-*juan* extent corresponds to the standard division of [吉藏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%90%89%E8%97%8F) Jízàng's *Yìshū* ([KR6d0024](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0024)); Dàowēi may have interpolated his annotations into a Tiāntái-school adaptation of Jízàng's structural framework.

The work is consequently of interest as a Sòng-period example of the *rùshū* editorial genre — a Sòng innovation in commentarial production that anticipated the late-Míng combined-edition (*huìběn*) genre by allowing readers to access an earlier text and a later commentator's annotations in unified form rather than in parallel separate texts. Dàowēi's *Rùshū* is one of the few surviving Sòng *rùshū* productions on a major Mahāyāna sūtra.

The dating is uncertain. Dàowēi's lifedates are not recorded; his productive period must postdate [知禮](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%9F%A5%E7%A6%AE) Zhīlǐ's mature work (early eleventh century) and predate the late-Sòng productive period of the *shānjiā* lineage. A defensible bracket of c. 1000–1200 covers his probable active period.
